fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, this is a brand-new current-model-year pontoon photographed on a dealer's boat show floor (Dan's Marine banner), with dealer-style copy listing available colors and horsepower options. It is dealer stock, not a private owner's used boat.
findings: Pontoon logs and fencing appear new and glossy in the show-floor side shot
Seats and woven flooring look factory-clean in the deck photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Starcraft VX 20 pontoon. The boat already looks show-floor clean, with bright pontoons and spotless seats. If you ever have trade-ins or used boats that need a pre-sale detail or gelcoat polish, we come to you. Would you like us to send over a quote for those?
